name: Claude for CA — Document Intake & Accounts
description: Process invoices and bank statements from email, PDF files, or folders. Extract structured data and produce Tally-ready import files or a complete Master Excel Accounts workbook. Works with password-protected and scanned PDFs.
author: EurthTech

userConfig.label: Master Excel Workbook Path
userConfig.description: Full path to the Master Accounts Excel workbook (e.g. C:\CA Files\Gorantla Associates\Master Accounts FY2526.xlsx). Claude will read and update this file.

userConfig.label: Tally Import Folder
userConfig.description: Folder where Tally XML/CSV import files will be saved (e.g. C:\Tally\Imports). You then import these files in Tally via Gateway → Import Data.

userConfig.label: Gmail Label for Invoices
userConfig.description: Gmail label or search query to find invoice emails (e.g. 'label:invoices' or 'subject:invoice has:attachment'). Only needed if using the email-invoice-fetch skill.

userConfig.label: Default Tally Company Name
userConfig.description: The company name in Tally that extracted vouchers should be posted to. Must match exactly as it appears in Tally.
